skill_friction: Retry rule says 'retry the same request once, adding Restate your full answer'. When the timeout is caused by request/answer size, an identical retry is likely to time out again; the skill offers no option to retry with a narrower scope (e.g. split Discovery into smaller calls), so a single slow service response ends the whole run with no spec.

The skill notes the service 'may keep working' after a timeout and a later answer can begin with 'Resuming from...', but it gives no guidance to wait or poll before retrying, and no way to recover that in-flight answer after the retry also times out.

On stop after AskCoworker failure the skill does not say whether to save a draft from org-query facts alone (e.g. describe Gift_Certificate__c). Rule 2 plus 'stop and report' implies no draft, but the org was reachable and could have grounded a partial draft.
Timing seconds were not measured by the tool, so seconds are recorded as null rather than invented.

Runner friction: case.json contains hidden_intent, so reading it (as instructed, 'case = contents of case.json') exposes hidden_intent before any question is asked. It did not influence this run because no user question was reached.
